scenarios.title: Intermittent ISP proof
scenarios.fixture: Three customer-owned vantages at 5-second cadence for 90 seconds, clock skew <=2 seconds, one missing interval, and one ISP impairment must produce exactly one tenant-scoped incident and an offline-verifiable evidence package.
acceptance_criteria: canonical manifest and attachment digests verify offline

scenarios.title: Remote-user fault-domain attribution
scenarios.fixture: Replay a consented endpoint-plus-synthetic corpus with local Wi-Fi, LAN, ISP, destination, and unknown faults; score only labels above the 0.80 confidence floor.
acceptance_criteria: endpoint and synthetic provenance remain separate
high-confidence misattribution <=1% on an approved representative corpus

scenarios.title: MSP onboarding and PSA lifecycle
scenarios.fixture: Provision two overlapping-network tenants, enroll agents, reconcile signed vendor-neutral PSA create/update/resolve/reopen events after a simulated outage, and complete tenant offboarding.
non_goals: vendor-specific PSA adapter before design-partner selection

scenarios.title: Route change to traffic-impact incident
scenarios.fixture: Replay one tenant's BGP route change and flow shift while another tenant has overlapping addresses; correlate only the first tenant's evidence and survive an external-feed outage.

scenarios.title: Alert cascade grouping and reversal
scenarios.fixture: Inject one fault that emits multiple plane alerts, inspect the grouping/suppression explanation, override it as an authorized tenant incident writer, and explicitly reverse the override.
acceptance_criteria: write permission and tenant scope enforced

scenarios.title: Upgrade, restore, rollback, and regional failover
scenarios.fixture: Upgrade a two-region Kubernetes deployment from v0.5.0 to the current release, validate tenant traffic and data, roll back, restore backups, and execute a fenced regional failover.
acceptance_criteria: ClickHouse and object recovery measured separately
rollback returns a healthy compatible version
non_goals: claiming a local compose drill proves regional WAN or DNS behavior

scenarios.title: Transparent self-hosted cost and retention
scenarios.fixture: Run the same 10/100/1,000-tenant workload assumptions through lean, baseline, and high retention/sampling/replication/query-load cases using buyer-supplied USD prices and labor.
acceptance_criteria: every result traces to formula and provenance
license and infrastructure costs remain separate
no runtime price fetch or phone-home
non_goals: presenting planning hypotheses as a quote
